title: Character size: playable 33% reduction trial
question: Does the 33% smaller character size fit the environment better?

media.caption: Actual playable game trial. The 67% option reduces human bodies by 33%; the default remains unchanged. Furniture, environment, cameras and movement coordinates keep their current scale. This uses main’s environment, separate from the sunny street WIP.

Seated body contact is preserved (about 9.45 mm into this cushion). Furniture now reads larger. This trial does not establish that every existing hand/prop interaction fits; those require a separate staging pass before adopting a new default.
